newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MERKO TO ORGANISE 70 MLN EEK SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: MERKO TO ORGANISE 70 MLN EEK SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Merko, one of the largest constructon companies in Estonia, will organise a public share issue worth 70 million kroons in late May or early June, Baltic Cresco said on Thursday.
"Merko's share issue will be in late May to early June," Indrek Rahumaa, Baltic Cresco's head of corporate fincance, told Reuters in an interview.
Baltic Cresco will handle the issue.

"The final details have not yet been approved by the shareholders' meeting, but it is expected to be around 70 million kroons with a nominal value of 10 kroons and an estimated sale price of 100 kroons," he added.
Rahumaa also said that the shareholders meeting is expected to be held within the week, but no firm date has been set as yet.
The company plans make the main list of the Tallinn stock exchange as soon as the share issue is completed.
"The 70 million kroons represents 25 percent of the company's equity to fulfill stock exhange requirements for listing," Rahumaa added.
The company's turnover in 1996 was 209 million kroons compared to 222 million kroons in 1995.
"The dfference in turnover has more to do with the accounting methods and whether an item was listed under revenue or income," Rahumaa said.
The company's 1996 net profit was 9.9 million kroons compared to 1995's 10.9 million kroons. The 1997 first quarter pre-tax results were over five million kroons, Rahumaa.
The listing of Merko will give Estonia two listed contruction companies. The other already on the free market is EMV, .
